item.title: Westmeath claim spoils in Division 2 derby
item.description: Westmeath edged Meath by 0-25 to 1-19 in Mullingar this afternoon to claim their first Allianz Hurling League Division 2 victory of the season.

item.title: Halloran hits 1-12 as Waterford condemn Offaly to third defeat
item.description: Waterford picked up their second win of the Allianz Hurling League Division 1A campaign by handing Offaly a 1-19 to 0-16 defeat at Walsh Park this afternoon.

item.title: Gillane goal helps Treaty men past Cats for first league win
item.description: Limerick earned their first points in this year's Allianz Hurling League campaign by handing Kilkenny a 1-26 to 2-16 defeat the TUS Gaelic Grounds this afternoon.

item.title: Sunday's Allianz Hurling and Football League results and tables
item.description: Here are this afternoon's results in the Allianz Hurling and Football Leagues...

item.title: Flanagan names new-look Kildare football squad
item.description: Kildare senior football manager Brian Flanagan has named his 2026 squad.

item.title: Jody Gormley remembered as Abbey CBS rescue MacRory Cup final replay
item.description: Abbey CBS remembered the late Jody Gormley by carrying his initials on their jersey sleeves as they rescued a draw with St Patrick's, Dungannon in a thrilling MacRory Cup final yesterday.

item.title: Tipp All-Star footballer joins Louth club
item.description: Former Tipperary All-Star forward Michael Quinlivan will play his club football in Louth this year after transferring from Clonmel Commercials to Dundalk Gaels.

item.title: Cahill condemns Páirc brawl
item.description: Tipperary manager Liam Cahill is adamant that the ugly scenes that marred his side's Allianz Hurling League Division 1A clash with Cork have no place in the game.

item.title: Double delight for Dowling
item.description: Brian Dowling enjoyed a memorable weekend which yielded two massive wins.

item.title: Cavan's Brady bows out
item.description: Long-serving Cavan defender Killian 'The Gunner' Brady has announced his inter-county retirement.
